text:
[issue by msoso38]
### Steps to Reproduce the Crash

Have you ever gotten past the crash condition without crashing, or does the game always crash? It always crash
What steps cause the crash? Launch modpack, connect to a server with custom domain name, open inventory while in creative and then open the JEI config icon

### Mod Pack URL (Optional)

https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/all-of-create-aeronautics

### Mod Pack Version (Optional)

1.21.1

### Extra Notes (Optional)

So it happens everytime and here are the server logs :
[16:45:51] [Netty Epoll Server IO #7/ERROR] [minecraft/Connection]: Exception caught in connection
io.netty.channel.unix.Errors$NativeIoException: recvAddress(..) failed: Connection reset by peer
[16:45:51] [Server thread/INFO] [minecraft/ServerGamePacketListenerImpl]: Msoso38 lost connection: Disconnected
[16:45:51] [Server thread/INFO] [minecraft/MinecraftServer]: Msoso38 left the game

### Crash Report

https://gist.github.com/msoso38/555cbafe06929124ebe03461e5e535c4

[comment by mezz (owner)]
Thanks for the report!

This looks like a FancyMenu compatibility bug, not a JEI or server failure.
The failure path is:
1. JEI cannot open an in-game config screen, so it displays a local message containing an `OPEN_FILE` link to the config folder.
2. FancyMenu 3.9.1 intercepts and serializes that message.
3. Minecraft rejects serializing the client-only `OPEN_FILE` action, producing `JsonParseException: Action not allowed: OPEN_FILE`.

Please report this issue to `FancyMenu` and link back to this issue in case they have questions or need support.

[comment by mezz (owner)]
It looks like this was already reported as FancyMenu [#1628](https://github.com/Keksuccino/FancyMenu/issues/1628) and fixed. The fix first shipped for Minecraft 1.21.1 in FancyMenu 3.9.7
